node.title: The ternary unification, GRADED AND GATED (round-19 attack-first): the OBJECT survives (T(P,Lambda) = ternary words of a negacyclic code; three exact dictionaries, the fourth instance demoted), the REGIME survives as satisfiability (THEOREM SR: an explicit shared admissible 256-bit prime row — the anti-(ES) result; no shared discharge), the METHOD survives as scaffold (12 verbatim transfers, every one vacuous at its target's tau), and the SINGLE-THEOREM form is KILLED by THEOREM PT — the phase transition at tau = g log2 p / h (I1 forced to tau = 1 supercritical where only MASS can be true; I2/I3 at tau = 2 subcritical where EMPTINESS is the target; four banked constants reproduced unfitted); with THEOREM MT (one threshold, three lanes), LEMMA BR, I3-FORCE, and the PT-2 watch line (the crossing bracket endpoint clears the threshold by 0.336 bits)
node.statement:
T(P,Lambda) = {eps in {0,±1}^M : sum eps_j theta_j^l = 0, l in Lambda}; PROPOSITION HS: for half-system P and Frobenius-stable unit Lambda this is exactly the ternary part of the negacyclic F_p-code of length h with defining set

Lambda, codim g. THREE instances specialize exactly (I1 = f2_z1_mass_knife_edge all-odd window mass; I2 = crossing_dsa_refutation deep stratum constant-weight; I3 = es_ternary_suppression_instruments odd sub-object; the round-18 fourth instance demoted — LEMMA TC's 3^L is I2's ambient cardinality). PROPOSITION FIB: every target = the eps = 0 term x (1 + delta) under binary-preimage multiplicity — I1's mass IS a count of binary pairs; the real split is constant-weight vs full-cube. SPINE PROVED: CZ-M (char-0 emptiness iff 2-power length; CATCH-Z6 as a rank statement); CS-M (CS verbatim for any Frobenius-stable unit Lambda via LEMMA BR: r' - a_{n/2}(S) = wt(A-B)); ROT-M (negacyclic closure iff all-odd Lambda — the official I1 window qualifies, coordinator adjudication; mixed-parity miniatures collapse to orbit size 2); Z-FLOOR-M (difference-multiplicity scope; Z-FLOOR ≡ DSA + support control). THEOREM MT: the three banked boundaries are the ONE inequality tau = g log2 p / h vs 1 (knife edge -46.0249/+17.9751 reproduced to four decimals by three independent derivations). THEOREM PT (kills the single-theorem form): I1 is FORCED to tau = 1 (saturation) — supercritical, only a MASS bound can be true (CATCH-Z1's re-pin forced by sign(Tcrit)); I2/I3 at tau = 2 — subcritical, EMPTINESS the target; per-tau targets of record: the tail-count criterion at tau = 1, emptiness at tau > 1; COROLLARY MX: norm and pigeonhole never simultaneously informative. THEOREM SR: v_2(p-1) = 41 with log2 p in [255.9113, 256) is admissible for all three AT ONCE (Dirichlet + MR exhibit) — the anti-(ES) result; no shared discharge. Instruments: 12 master-level verbatim transfers, all vacuous at their target's tau (scaffold, not weapon); new: I3-FORCE (the odd-condition exclusion mechanism provably FAILS below threshold on named tower rows), Z-1 -> I3 (wt >= w+1), THEOREM 7 (Z_1 <= 2^{0.8908 S} unconditional), LEMMA TWT/SELF-ORTH (non-split primes only), the exact 1+cos form + tail-count criterion. WATCH (PT-2): the crossing bracket's proved lower endpoint clears the ternary threshold by 0.336 bits — re-run on any bracket change. The CRITICALITY-COMPATIBILITY gate (common non-vacuous tau-interval) is adopted as the standing third unification test. NOT claimed: the I1 mass bound (no named route); mid-range primes; CC-sparsity; the even-condition recursion; the (1, 1.585) heuristic band; any shared discharge. Provenance: the four round-19 pilot dirs (92,263 + 54 + 412 + 137 checks, all 0 fail, all coordinator-replayed); the four FABLE_AUDITs carry the adjudications (I4 demotion, CATCH-19A/19B re-scopes, the quarantine rule, PT-2).
